name: Voice Chat
author: Flubsound (Flubes & Claude)
description: For the Chat strip: Discord, Teams, Zoom and in-game voice. Rumble below 110 Hz and boxiness are removed, presence is lifted for intelligibility, and a speech leveller (Auto Level at -19 LUFS plus a syllable-speed compressor and upward compression) brings quiet and loud teammates to about the same level, -18 to -20 LUFS short-term. No loudness maximizing: the maximizer is only its true-peak limiter (no drive, no clipper, no glue), and Boost stays below the point where it adds drive. Flubsound loads it on a fresh Chat strip.
